Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (8g), Carbohydrates (30g), Fiber (4g), Sodium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Besan (Gram flour), Semolina (Sooji), Lemon juice / Citric acid, Baking soda / Fruit salt, Sugar, Mustard seeds, Green chillies, Curry leaves, Sesame seeds, Asafoetida (Hing), Oil, Fresh coriander
Recipe Instructions: 1. Whisk besan, sooji, water, sugar, salt, and citric acid into a smooth batter; stir in fruit salt and immediately steam in a greased plate for 15 minutes. 2. Cut steamed fluffy khaman into squares. 3. Prepare tempering in oil with mustard seeds, sesame seeds, green chillies, curry leaves, and hing. Add a splash of sweetened water to tempering and pour over khaman.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (8g), Carbohydrates (29g), Fiber (4g), Iron
Ingredients Required: Besan, Citric acid, Fruit salt (Eno), Sugar, Salt, Mustard seeds, Green chillies, Sesame seeds, Hing, Oil, Fresh coriander
Recipe Instructions: 1. Prepare besan batter with sugar, salt, citric acid, and water. Stir in fruit salt and steam for 12-15 minutes until spongy. 2. Temper mustard seeds, sesame seeds, hing, and green chillies in oil with a little water and sugar. 3. Pour tempering over steamed khaman squares and garnish with coriander.

Key Nutrients: Protein (9g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (62g), Fiber (3g), Sodium, Calcium
Ingredients Required: Besan, Carom seeds (Ajwain), Papad khar, Turmeric, Oil for deep frying, Maida, Curd, Sugar syrup, Saffron, Cardamom, Raw papaya (for Sambharo), Green chillies
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead besan with ajwain, papad khar, oil, turmeric, and water into a soft dough. Stretch dough on a wooden board with palm and scrape into long strips; deep fry on low flame till crisp. 2. Fry fermented maida spiral jalebis and soak in saffron sugar syrup. Serve crispy Fafda with sweet Jalebi and warm papaya Sambharo.

Key Nutrients: Protein (9g), Fat (22g), Carbohydrates (61g), Fiber (3g), Sodium
Ingredients Required: Besan, Ajwain, Papad khar, Turmeric, Oil, Maida, Sugar, Saffron, Cardamom, Raw papaya, Mustard seeds, Hing, Green chillies
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead besan dough with ajwain, papad khar, and oil. Drag dough on board and deep fry long crisp strips (Fafda). 2. Prepare jalebis and soak in saffron syrup. 3. Sauté grated raw papaya with mustard seeds, green chillies, and hing for Jain Papaya Sambharo.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (38g), Fiber (5g), Iron, Calcium
Ingredients Required: Whole wheat flour, Fresh fenugreek leaves (Methi), Curd, Sesame seeds, Carom seeds (Ajwain), Turmeric, Red chilli powder, Coriander-cumin powder, Oil / Ghee
Recipe Instructions: 1. Combine wheat flour, finely chopped fresh methi leaves, curd, sesame seeds, ajwain, spices, and oil; knead into a soft dough without adding much water. 2. Roll into thin rotis. 3. Cook on a hot tawa applying oil/ghee on both sides until light brown spots appear.

Dish Name: Jain Kathiyawadi Bajra Na Rotla with Lasaniyu Marchu (Egg-Free non-veg style Kathiyawadi Thali option)
Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (48g), Fiber (8g), Magnesium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Bajra flour (Pearl millet), Warm water, Oil, Red chilli powder, Cumin seeds, Lemon juice, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead bajra flour with warm water and salt into a smooth dough using palms; flatten by hand into thick rotla. 2. Bake on clay tawa (Tavdi) over medium heat, flipping until cooked and puffed. 3. Serve hot with spicy crushed red chilli-cumin chutney (Jain style, without garlic).

Dish Name: Kathiyawadi Sev Tameta Nu Shaak with Bajra Rotla
Key Nutrients: Protein (12g), Fat (20g), Carbohydrates (56g), Fiber (9g), Vit C, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Ripe tomatoes, Thick Sev (Gathiya), Mustard seeds, Cumin seeds, Ginger-garlic paste, Green chillies, Hing, Kashmiri red chilli powder, Dhana jeeru, Jaggery, Ghee / Oil, Bajra flour
Recipe Instructions: 1. Heat oil/ghee, temper mustard seeds, cumin, hing, ginger-garlic, and green chillies. 2. Add chopped tomatoes, dry spices, salt, and jaggery; cook until tomatoes turn soft and oil separates. 3. Add water, bring to boil, fold in thick sev just before serving. Serve piping hot with thick hand-patted Bajra Rotla.

Dish Name: Jain Sev Tameta Nu Shaak with Bajra Rotla
Key Nutrients: Protein (12g), Fat (19g), Carbohydrates (55g), Fiber (9g), Vit C, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Ripe tomatoes, Thick Sev, Mustard seeds, Cumin seeds, Hing, Green chillies, Kashmiri red chilli powder, Dhana jeeru, Jaggery, Ghee / Oil, Bajra flour
Recipe Instructions: 1. Heat oil/ghee, temper mustard, cumin, hing, and green chillies (no garlic or ginger). 2. Cook chopped tomatoes with chilli powder, dhana jeeru, salt, and jaggery till oil separates. 3. Add water, simmer, add sev, and serve immediately with thick Bajra Rotla.

Dish Name: Gujarati Khati Meethi Dal with Steamed Rice
Key Nutrients: Protein (14g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (60g), Fiber (6g), Folate, Vit C
Ingredients Required: Toor dal, Peanuts, Kokum / Tamarind, Jaggery, Ginger-green chilli paste, Tomatoes, Mustard seeds, Cumin, Methi seeds, Cloves, Cinnamon, Curry leaves, Hing, Ghee
Recipe Instructions: 1. Pressure cook toor dal and blend smoothly. 2. Add boiled peanuts, kokum, jaggery, ginger-chilli paste, chopped tomatoes, turmeric, and salt; simmer for 15 mins. 3. Temper ghee with mustard, cumin, methi seeds, cloves, cinnamon, curry leaves, and hing; pour into dal and boil.

Key Nutrients: Protein (14g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (58g), Fiber (6g), Folate
Ingredients Required: Toor dal, Peanuts, Kokum, Jaggery, Green chillies, Tomatoes, Mustard seeds, Cumin, Cloves, Cinnamon, Curry leaves, Hing, Ghee, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Pressure cook toor dal and churn smoothly. 2. Boil dal with peanuts, kokum, jaggery, slit green chillies, tomatoes, turmeric, and salt. 3. Prepare ghee tempering with mustard seeds, cumin, cloves, cinnamon, curry leaves, and generous hing (no ginger); pour over dal and simmer.

Key Nutrients: Protein (5g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (28g), Fiber (9g), Vit C, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Large Eggplant (Ringan), Spring onions / Dry onions, Garlic cloves, Green chillies, Tomatoes, Oil, Mustard seeds, Cumin, Red chilli powder, Dhana jeeru, Turmeric
Recipe Instructions: 1. Smear eggplant with oil and roast directly over gas flame until charred and soft; peel skin and mash. 2. Heat oil in a kadai, temper mustard and cumin seeds. 3. Add crushed garlic, green chillies, onions, and tomatoes; sauté till cooked. Fold in mashed roasted eggplant, dry spices, and roast on medium flame for 10 minutes.

Key Nutrients: Protein (10g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (42g), Fiber (6g), Calcium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Rice, Chana dal, Toor dal, Urad dal, Curd, Grated Bottle Gourd (Dudhi), Carrots, Ginger-green chilli paste, Baking soda, Mustard seeds, Sesame seeds, Curry leaves, Hing, Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Soak rice and lentils, grind with curd into coarse batter, ferment overnight. 2. Mix in grated dudhi, carrots, ginger-chilli paste, spices, and baking soda. 3. Heat oil in pan, temper mustard, sesame seeds, curry leaves, hing, pour batter, cover and cook on low heat till crust turns golden brown and crispy on both sides.

Key Nutrients: Protein (10g), Fat (12g), Carbohydrates (40g), Fiber (6g), Calcium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Rice, Chana dal, Toor dal, Urad dal, Sour curd, Grated Bottle Gourd (Dudhi), Green chillies, Baking soda, Mustard seeds, Sesame seeds, Curry leaves, Hing, Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Soak rice and lentils, grind with sour curd, and ferment. 2. Add grated dudhi (no carrot or ginger), green chillies, salt, hing, and baking soda. 3. Temper mustard, sesame seeds, and hing in a pan; pour batter, cover and slow cook till golden and crunchy on the outside.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (52g), Fiber (5g), Sodium, Vit C
Ingredients Required: Boiled potatoes, Dabeli masala, Tamarind-date chutney, Garlic chutney, Pomegranate seeds, Roasted spiced peanuts, Sev, Ladi Pav, Butter
Recipe Instructions: 1. Sauté boiled mashed potatoes with Dabeli masala and tamarind chutney. Transfer to a plate, garnish with spiced peanuts, pomegranate seeds, fresh coriander, and sev. 2. Slit pav, apply sweet tamarind and spicy garlic chutney, stuff with potato filling. 3. Toast in butter on tawa and roll edges in crunchy sev.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (13g), Carbohydrates (50g), Fiber (6g), Potassium
Ingredients Required: Boiled Raw Bananas (mashed), Dabeli masala, Date-tamarind chutney, Red chilli-hing chutney, Pomegranate seeds, Spiced peanuts, Sev, Jain Pav / Bread, Butter
Recipe Instructions: 1. Cook mashed raw bananas with dabeli masala and tamarind chutney. Top with pomegranate, peanuts, and sev. 2. Spread red chilli-hing chutney and sweet chutney on pav. 3. Stuff with banana filling, toast in butter, and roll in sev.

Key Nutrients: Protein (14g), Fat (26g), Carbohydrates (64g), Fiber (12g), Vit A, Vit C, Iron
Ingredients Required: Surti Papdi (Flat beans), Purple Yam (Kand), Sweet potato, Small Brinjals, Raw banana, Fresh Tuvar, Muthiya (steamed/fried fenugreek-besan dumplings), Fresh grated coconut, Sesame seeds, Green garlic, Ginger-chilli paste, Ajwain, Sugar, Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Prepare Muthiya dumplings from fenugreek leaves and besan; deep fry. 2. Make masala paste with grated coconut, sesame seeds, green garlic, ginger-chilli paste, coriander, and sugar. 3. Stuff brinjals and bananas with masala paste. Layer beans, Kand, sweet potato, stuffed veggies, muthiya, and oil in heavy pot; slow cook until tender. Serve with hot puffed puris.

Key Nutrients: Protein (14g), Fat (25g), Carbohydrates (60g), Fiber (12g), Vit C, Calcium
Ingredients Required: Surti Papdi, Small Brinjals, Raw banana, Fresh Tuvar, Jain Methi Muthiya (without garlic), Grated coconut, Sesame seeds, Green chillies, Ajwain, Hing, Sugar, Oil, Wheat flour for puris
Recipe Instructions: 1. Make methi muthiya without garlic/ginger and fry. 2. Mix masala using coconut, sesame seeds, green chillies, coriander, hing, and sugar (strictly no root veggies like kand, potato, or green garlic). 3. Stuff brinjals and raw banana, layer with flat beans and muthiya, slow cook in oil. Serve with hot puris.

Key Nutrients: Protein (5g), Fat (16g), Carbohydrates (42g), Fiber (5g), Vit C, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Baby potatoes (boiled & peeled), Red chilli-garlic paste, Oil, Cumin seeds, Mustard seeds, Hing, Turmeric, Dhana jeeru, Garam masala, Salt, Fresh coriander
Recipe Instructions: 1. Grind lots of garlic cloves with whole red chillies and water into a smooth fiery red paste. 2. Heat generous oil, temper mustard, cumin, and hing. Add garlic-chilli paste and sauté till oil separates. 3. Toss boiled baby potatoes in spicy paste, season with dhana jeeru, salt, and roast on medium flame till crispy red.

Key Nutrients: Protein (5g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (22g), Fiber (7g), Vit C, Calcium
Ingredients Required: Fresh Bhindi (Okra), Roasted Besan, Crushed peanuts, Grated coconut, Dhana jeeru, Red chilli powder, Turmeric, Hing, Amchur powder, Sugar, Oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Slit bhindi vertically. 2. Prepare stuffing mix using roasted besan, crushed peanuts, dry coconut, dhana jeeru, red chilli powder, turmeric, hing, amchur, sugar, salt, and oil. 3. Stuff bhindi tightly, heat oil in pan, add stuffed bhindi, cover and cook on low flame till tender and crisp.

Key Nutrients: Protein (10g), Fat (16g), Carbohydrates (44g), Fiber (0g), Calcium, Vit D
Ingredients Required: Full-cream Milk, Sugar, Saffron strands, Cardamom powder, Nutmeg, Charoli (Chironji), Chopped almonds & pistachios
Recipe Instructions: 1. Boil full-cream milk in a wide pan and reduce to half volume while scraping thick cream from sides. 2. Add sugar, saffron milk, cardamom, nutmeg, and nuts. 3. Simmer for 10 minutes until golden and creamy. Serve warm or chilled.

Key Nutrients: Protein (8g), Fat (14g), Carbohydrates (45g), Fiber (0g), Calcium, Probiotics
Ingredients Required: Fresh Curd (strained into Chakka), Powdered sugar, Saffron dissolved in warm milk, Cardamom powder, Slivered almonds, Pistachios
Recipe Instructions: 1. Hang fresh curd in cotton cloth overnight to remove whey and obtain thick Chakka. 2. Whisk chakka with powdered sugar until smooth and silky. 3. Fold in saffron milk, cardamom powder, and nuts. Chill in refrigerator before serving.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (24g), Carbohydrates (52g), Fiber (2g), Calcium, Magnesium
Ingredients Required: Coarse Besan (Gram flour), Desi Ghee, Milk, Sugar syrup (1.5 string), Cardamom powder, Saffron, Slivered almonds and pistachios
Recipe Instructions: 1. Mix coarse besan with milk and ghee (Dhabo process) and crumble through sieve. 2. Slow roast besan in ghee till deep golden brown and fragrant. 3. Prepare sugar syrup with saffron and cardamom, pour into roasted besan, stir well, set in greased tray, and cut into squares.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (20g), Carbohydrates (48g), Fiber (4g), Iron, Calcium
Ingredients Required: Coarse Whole Wheat Flour (Gehu Ka Atta), Desi Ghee, Organic Jaggery (Gur), Cardamom powder
Recipe Instructions: 1. Melt ghee in a heavy kadai, add coarse wheat flour, and slow roast on low heat until golden brown and nutty-aromatic. 2. Turn off heat completely. Add soft chopped jaggery and cardamom powder; mix rapidly until jaggery melts into roasted flour. 3. Immediately pour into greased plate, smooth top, and cut into diamond squares while warm.
